assertions.title: Database Migration Up/Down Reversibility
assertions.summary: migrate up/down/up succeeded on a fresh temporary database; all recorded exit codes were 0, migrate down returned version 0, only schema_migrations tooling objects remained after down, and the normalized first/second schema dumps matched.

steps.action: Create a fresh temporary PostgreSQL database
steps.expected: An isolated janus_ut_bh_ database is ready for validation

steps.action: Run migrate up and capture schema dump
steps.expected: The latest migration version applies cleanly
steps.observed: first up exit code 0; helper reported 'up: success'; version check returned 'version=3 dirty=false'

steps.action: Run migrate down and inspect remaining public objects
steps.expected: Migration returns to version 0 with no application tables/sequences/indexes remaining
steps.observed: down exit code 0; version check returned 'version=0 dirty=false'; remaining public objects were only index:schema_migrations_pkey and table:schema_migrations

steps.action: Run migrate up again and compare normalized schema dumps
steps.expected: Second up succeeds and the application schema matches the first up
steps.observed: second up exit code 0; version check returned 'version=3 dirty=false'; normalized schema diff file was empty

frictions.description: The helper path referenced in the assignment was not present in the checked-out module tree, so an equivalent temporary helper was created inside backend/janus-api/cmd, used for the run, and deleted afterward.
frictions.resolution: Built and used a temporary helper within the module tree, then removed both the helper source directory and compiled binary in cleanup.

summary: Tested 1 assertion: 1 passed. VAL-BH-001 now passes on a fresh temporary database with clean up/down/up exit codes and matching normalized schema dumps.
